body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4653` (pool: codex-personal), single commit on base `306ef16aa`.

**Tests:** no test command

**Tier-1 (CODEOWNERS) paths, async post-merge review:** .github/CODEOWNERS scripts/build-sea.mjs test/config/realio-lane-membership.mjs

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4653

## Status

Prepared the conflict resolution locally, uncommitted. **Not pushed or enqueued.**
The task's final RULES explicitly prohibit commits, pushes, tags and publication;
those restrictions prevent completing its earlier remote-update acceptance criteria.
No new PR was opened and no existing remote branch was changed.

- Existing PR: https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/pull/4653 (open, conflicting).
- Existing head: `masonwyatt23/phantom:codex-bridge/RQ-PHX-RECUTNONPHXNEW62`.
- Existing head SHA: `12486ded3e76b5abc01d3ed3930d0f9787bb3c2d`.
- Local integration base: `2e1f5f4c6785e6392bbb70db041249b92dccbd4d` (`origin/master`).
- Local branch remains `codex-bridge/RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4653`.
- GitHub connector reported no Actions runs for the original head. It reported a
  failing Vercel status, which is excluded by the task. Merge Gate success is
  **unverified**; local checks cannot establish hosted CI acceptance.

## Resolution

Replayed the PR's single commit with `git cherry-pick --no-commit` on current
master. Release/workflow/Feed changes were already present. Kept current version
metadata and current mobile routing, including Goals and Ideas. Removed a stale
changelog freshness insertion from the replay. No workflow, release, security or
web UI differences remain against the integration base.

The remaining paths implement and qualify the original CLI registry change:

- `scripts/lib/cli-registry-sort.mjs`: preserve the PR's pure sorting helpers.
- `scripts/sort-cli-registries.mjs`: preserve its sorter and `--check` command.
- `src/cli/completions.ts`: derive top-level completions from current help and
  sort current subcommands. All 97 current subcommand entries are byte-for-byte
  equivalent as parsed values, including newer agents, bus, fleet, routines,
  usage, verify, wb, caps and land entries.
- `test/cli-registry-merge-friendly.test.ts`: preserve the PR's nine tests and
  add bash/zsh regression cases for subcommands introduced since the PR opened.
- `src/cli/help.ts`: register the dispatched `ideas` command so help-derived
  completions remain complete. Fix the related suites' seven missing intent
  tool names and clarify the console's compatible `/verse/` and `/app/` routes.
- `docs/CLI-REFERENCE.md`: regenerate from source help; also captures a handful
  of existing documentation discrepancies, eight changed lines total.
- `.github/CODEOWNERS`: generated ownership entry for the new Tier-1 test.
  **New Tier-1 test:** `test/cli-registry-merge-friendly.test.ts`. No new Tier-1
  source roots or runtime closure growth; the existing snapshot passed unchanged.
- `test/config/realio-lane-membership.mjs`: classify the new subprocess test in
  the real-I/O lane rather than exempting it from the membership guard.

## Commands and evidence

### Setup and repository reads

- `node --version`: PASS, `v22.22.3`.
- `npm install -g @ashlr/phantom`: FAIL, OS denied writes to the global prefix.
- `phm --version`: PASS, existing installation `3.30.31`.
- `phm docs --agent --json`, `phm help`: PASS; read installed command registry.
- Read `docs/AGENT-MCP-CLI.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- `phm mcp list --json`: PASS, discovery only.
- `phm mcp doctor --json`: completed; several companion servers unavailable.
- `phm wire status --json`: FAIL, editor registrations unavailable/unwired and
  configuration access denied. No editor or authentication configuration changed.
- `phm authority status --json`: reports paused grant/effective switch off.
- `phm authority setup --dry-run --json`: reports incomplete setup; no activation.
- `gh pr view 4653 -R ashlrai/phantom --json number,state,url,title,headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup`:
  FAIL, OS denied reading `~/.config/gh/config.yml`.
- Connected GitHub `get_pr_info`, `get_commit_combined_status` and
  `fetch_commit_workflow_runs`: retrieved PR state, original status and run
  inventory without reading local credentials. Initial parameter-validation
  failures were corrected; one unused changed-file query failed validation.
- `git status --short --branch`, `git remote -v`, `git log`, `git diff`,
  `git rev-parse`, `git merge-base` and targeted source reads inspected state.
- `git fetch origin master` and
  `git fetch origin pull/4653/head:refs/remotes/origin/pr-4653`: PASS.
- `git fetch --deepen=2000 origin master`: PASS; repaired missing merge-base
  history. Earlier three-dot diff/merge-base attempts failed on the shallow tree.
- `git merge --ff-only origin/master`: failed before history deepening completed;
  no merge created. `git reset --keep origin/master` moved the clean local job
  branch to the fetched base without creating a commit.
- `git cherry-pick --no-commit origin/pr-4653`: first attempt encountered the
  preceding reset's index lock; retry applied the commit with 16 conflicts.
  Resolved stale release/mobile conflicts from current HEAD, rebuilt completions
  from the incoming derivation and current subcommands, then
  `git add src/cli/completions.ts` and `git cherry-pick --quit` cleared sequencer
  state without creating a commit.
- `pnpm --version`: first invocation saw the transient conflicted package.json;
  later invocation PASS, `10.28.2`.
- `npm run install:worktree`: PASS, frozen pnpm installation and both configured
  dependency-healing steps succeeded. Only ignored dependencies changed.

### Verification

- `node scripts/sort-cli-registries.mjs`: PASS, canonicalized current subcommands.
- `node scripts/sort-cli-registries.mjs --check`: PASS.
- `git diff HEAD --check`: initially found the incoming test's extra EOF blank
  line; corrected it, then PASS.
- A Node source comparison parsed pre/post SUBCOMMANDS and compared all entries:
  PASS, all 97 preserved exactly.
- `npm run check:docs`: PASS, 261 local links, 400 source links, zero errors.
- First `npm run typecheck`: FAIL before dependency repair, `tsgo` absent.
- First `npm run lint`: FAIL before dependency repair, ESLint's `lib/cli` absent.
- `env HOME="$(mktemp -d)" npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false test/cli-registry-merge-friendly.test.ts test/cli-registry-drift.test.ts test/m31.cli-agent.test.ts test/m32.help.test.ts`:
  initially 61 PASS / 5 FAIL. Failures exposed the missing `ideas` help entry,
  missing intent tool inventory and console help wording; fixed all three causes.
- `env HOME="$(mktemp -d)" npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false test/cli-registry-merge-friendly.test.ts test/cli-registry-drift.test.ts`:
  PASS, 17 tests / 0 failures after adding the `ideas` entry.
- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs`: one foreground invocation, FAIL on missing
  CODEOWNERS entry (8 PASS / 2 FAIL in authority suites). The Tier-1 closure
  suite passed all 4 tests. Did not rerun this command on the revised tree;
  verified its failing ownership check separately after regeneration.
- `env HOME="$(mktemp -d)" ASHLR_UPDATE_CODEOWNERS=1 npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false test/authority-codeowners-310b.test.ts`:
  PASS, one regeneration test. Added exactly one ownership line. Did not run
  `npm run authority:regen`, which also rewrites the Mason-only closure snapshot.
- Retried `npm run typecheck` after dependency repair: PASS, backend and web.
- Changed-file ESLint command: PASS:
  `node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js src/cli/completions.ts src/cli/help.ts scripts/lib/cli-registry-sort.mjs scripts/sort-cli-registries.mjs test/cli-registry-merge-friendly.test.ts test/config/realio-lane-membership.mjs`.
- `npm run lint:realio-lane`: FAIL on 17 pre-existing, unrelated test files.
  The new registry test is correctly classified and absent from the failures.
- `env HOME="$(mktemp -d)" node --import tsx scripts/generate-cli-reference.ts`:
  PASS (regenerated again after correcting help wording).
- Repeated `npm run check:docs`: PASS after the final help/documentation changes.
- `env HOME="$(mktemp -d)" npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false test/cli-registry-merge-friendly.test.ts test/cli-registry-drift.test.ts test/m31.cli-agent.test.ts test/m32.help.test.ts test/cli-reference-drift.test.ts`:
  PASS, **68 tests / 0 failures**, including the new test in the real-I/O lane.
- `env HOME="$(mktemp -d)" npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false test/authority-codeowners-310b.test.ts`:
  first normal validation had 5 PASS / 1 timeout at the existing 30-second limit.
  Retried unchanged after the broader suites ended: **6 PASS / 0 failures**.
  No timeout, assertion or security control was weakened.
- Full `npm run lint`: retried after dependency repair, then interrupted with
  Ctrl-C after more than 13 minutes without a result (exit 130). Full-tree
  ESLint completion is **unverified**. Changed-file ESLint passed; the separate
  membership guard fails on 17 unrelated existing files, so the full lint
  pipeline is not green independently of the interrupted ESLint phase.

## Counts

Before this notes file: eight implementation/test paths, +343/-171, **net +172
LOC**. Including this report: nine paths, +496/-171, **net +325 LOC**.

`toolsUsed: []` (no direct Phantom companion MCP tools called; GitHub connector
reads and Phantom CLI discovery are recorded above).

## Remaining work

The existing PR still needs a permitted update of its existing fork head through
the sanctioned `publish.sh`, followed by hosted Merge Gate validation and
`gh pr merge 4653 -R ashlrai/phantom`. These actions were not executed under the
explicit no-commit/no-push rules. No admin override, branch/tag deletion, live
dispatcher installation, release or paid action was performed.

All eight implementation/test paths and this report are unstaged and
uncommitted. The local branch points at the existing integration-base commit;
there is no new commit to publish. The original PR head is unchanged. For any
authorized follow-up, preserve that PR and its fork branch rather than opening
a replacement pull request. The CODEOWNERS handoff must name the new Tier-1
test above for review.
